name: r34-final-draft-ci-read
command:
gh pr view 438 --repo SobolGaming/Warhammer_40k_AI --json url,isDraft,headRefOid,baseRefOid,statusCheckRollup > /private/tmp/order34-evidence/r34-final-draft-ci.json
.venv/bin/python -c 'import json; from pathlib import Path; r=json.loads(Path("/private/tmp/order34-evidence/r34-final-draft-ci.json").read_text()); print(json.dumps({"head":r["headRefOid"],"base":r["baseRefOid"],"draft":r["isDraft"],"checks":[{"name":v["name"],"status":v["status"],"conclusion":v["conclusion"]} for v in r["statusCheckRollup"]]},indent=2))'
